_about: Round 121: the end-of-life summary (scripts/systems/Lives.gd). When you fall, a card says what this life did, what you were nearly at, and one thing to try. tips: keywords are matched against what killed you.
title: This life, in short

tips.text: A big blow shows a ring first. Roll through it (Ctrl) or parry it (tap right mouse / GRD) -- blocking won't stop it.
Poison ticks for a few seconds. A salve (1) mends it; keep one for fights with green-tinted foes.
Fire keeps hurting while you stand in it. Step out, and don't fight on the glowing floor.
Traps are spotted by walking slowly or with sense. A Delver path and Spirit Sense both help.
Ranged foes lose to cover. Break their line with a wall, then close in -- or answer with a bow of your own.
A master changes at two thirds and a third of its health. Learn its first big move, then fight in the quiet after it.

general_tips: A salve (1) heals in a fight; a qi pill (2) does not. Drink before you are in trouble, not once you are.
Retreat is a move. A foe that loses you stops hunting; come back with full health.
Parry staggers a foe and opens it to harder hits. Tap guard just as the blow lands.
Your Path's art (key 6) is a few seconds of being much better at your job. Use it at the start of a hard fight.
Sitting (M) at a shrine heals and gathers qi; do it before a master, not after.
